Beyond Section 508

Pages that check the WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 rules and best practices of the --wcag 2.2 profile:

  • Label in name and input purpose
  • Target size
  • Text spacing
  • Orientation
  • Focus not obscured
  • Reflow at 320 pixels
  • Non-text contrast and CJK text
  • Best practices
